audit_scope.description: Trust model for Paris (The Merge) block processing/consensus/transactions/gas economics/validation, EIP-2255 (wallet permissions), hexadecimal utility conversions, Cancun precompile mapping, and Cancun VM memory operations. Covers post-merge block validation, wallet permission security, input parsing safety, precompile dispatch, and memory management.

out_of_scope: Wallet permission system (EIP-2255 - wallet/dapp layer concern)

misclassified_entities.reason: Calling Contract from Cancun precompile mapping is internal to the EVM. Contracts making CALL/STATICCALL to precompile addresses are within the EVM execution context.

Potentially Malicious dApp from EIP-2255 SSRF protection is a threat model construct. While it is an external entity, the SSRF concern is wallet-layer, not EL-layer. Included in trusted_external_entities for completeness since it has a clear boundary edge.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain Consensus Layer (Paris)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: PoS consensus layer proposing execution payloads. Communicates via authenticated Engine API with JWT. Payloads must still pass EL validation: zero difficulty, zero nonce, empty ommers hash, state root verification.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain Validator (Paris)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: PoS validator that proposed or attested to the block. Validators are staked and subject to slashing, providing economic security guarantees. Semi-trusted due to skin in the game.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Sender (Paris)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External account submitting EIP-1559 transactions. Full validation required: gas available, sender recovery, nonce match, fee cap constraints (max_fee >= max_priority_fee), balance sufficient, sender is EOA.

trusted_external_entities.name: Decentralized Application (EIP-2255)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External dApp requesting wallet permissions. Must be identified by invoker origin. User consent required for restricted methods. Caveats restrict permission scope.

trusted_external_entities.name: dApp Caller (EIP-2255)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: dApp attempting to call restricted methods. Permission must exist with matching invoker and parentCapability. All caveats must be satisfied.

trusted_external_entities.name: Potentially Malicious dApp (EIP-2255 SSRF)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: dApp attempting SSRF via crafted URLs in permission requests. URL scheme and port must be validated against whitelists to prevent local service access.

trusted_external_entities.name: Hex Input Source (hexadecimal utils)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Hexadecimal string parsing functions (hex_to_bytes, hex_to_uint256, etc.)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External source of hex strings from JSON-RPC, configs, or test data. Invalid characters could cause runtime exceptions. No explicit error handling documented.

trusted_external_entities.name: Untrusted Input Source (hex type safety)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Potentially malformed hex strings at system boundary. Right-justify padding enforces fixed output sizes (8, 32, 256 bytes). Type wrappers (U8, U64, U256) must enforce bounds.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Execution payload must pass full validation: sequential block number, increasing timestamp, gas limit bounds, zero difficulty, zero nonce, empty ommers hash (0x1dcc4de8...), state/tx/receipt root verification.
Fork choice provides head, safe, and finalized block hashes. Canonical head updated. Finalized blocks become irreversible. Competing forks pruned after finalization.
Gas available, sender recovered, nonce matches, max_fee >= max_priority_fee, balance >= gas*max_fee + value, sender is EOA. Max fee deducted upfront. Refund capped at 20%. Priority fee to coinbase.
User must explicitly consent. Permission stored with invoker, parentCapability, and caveats. Error 4001 returned on rejection per EIP-1193.
Permission required for restricted methods. Lookup by invoker and parentCapability. All caveats must be satisfied. No permission = method denied.
URL scheme must be in whitelist (http, https). Port must be in whitelist. Blocks SSRF to local services.

Input assumed to contain only valid hex characters. 0x prefix handled. Fixed-size outputs padded with leading zeros via rjust. Python's int()/fromhex() raise ValueError for invalid input but caller must handle.

coverage_gaps: EXT-CALLER-CONTRACT-PRECOMPILE was misclassified as external - internal EVM component
EXT-UNTRUSTED-INPUT-HEX is a variant of EXT-HEX-INPUT-SOURCE, covered by same boundary edge
Cancun VM memory operations (read/write/expansion) have no external entities - purely internal EVM
Precompile dispatch is internal EVM routing with no external boundary
